nodes.label: BloomBlur.frag
nodes.rationale: One axis of a separable Gaussian blur, run twice per frame (horizontal then vertical) on the quarter-res bright-pass output.

nodes.label: PostUniformBufferObject (set 0, binding 0)
nodes.rationale: One shared uniform block declared identically in all three bloom fragment shaders, carrying texelSize, blurDir, threshold, knee, bloomIntensity, exposure, debugFlags and time.

nodes.label: Separable Gaussian blur (two 1D passes)
nodes.rationale: A 2D Gaussian is separable into two 1D passes costing 2*N taps instead of N*N; the axis for a given draw is chosen entirely by post.blurDir, (1,0) then (0,1).

nodes.label: Rejected 5-fetch bilinear-tap blur optimization
nodes.rationale: The paired-weight bilinear tap trick was deliberately not used: its per-kernel arithmetic silently biases the blur when wrong, and at quarter res the four extra fetches are cheap enough that the risk isn't worth it.
